name: cache-warm
description: Keeps an idle session's prompt cache warm while the last reply waits for the owner: one tool-less fork of the session every TTL minus 10 minutes, for a window per session (/warm)

defaultHours.title: Default window, hours
defaultHours.description: How long after a reply the cache is kept warm in a session that set no window of its own; `/warm default <n>` overrides it.

ttlMinutes.title: Prompt cache TTL, minutes
ttlMinutes.description: The session's prompt-cache lifetime (60 for the 1-hour cache, 5 for the default one). With 5 the mod does not warm: a read every 4 minutes costs more than one rewrite.
